card.title: Pick a Priority
card.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents' gravy needs stirring and you need a lift to the station. Which am I doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you leave dinner on a timer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It won't stir the gravy. Do I finish their dinner or drive you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finish dinner. I'll book a taxi. Just carry my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose again: suitcase downstairs now, or gravy without lumps for your parents?

mechanism: A forces B to choose between urgent cooking and transport-related tasks, renewing the binary when a solution adds another request.
confusable: Unlike asking for help generally, A must present competing obligations as unable to wait together.
comparison: D34-a turns a suitcase favor into another gravy choice; D34-b turns a phone call into another collection-deadline choice.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
